# preprocessing.exog_providers.EntsoeDayAheadPriceProvider { #spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.EntsoeDayAheadPriceProvider }

```python
preprocessing.exog_providers.EntsoeDayAheadPriceProvider(data_home=None)
```

ENTSO-E day-ahead spot price (DE/LU) as an exogenous input.

Reads ``interim/day_ahead_price.csv`` via
`spotforecast2_safe.data.fetch_data.load_day_ahead_price`. The day-ahead
auction price is published on D-1 and is leakage-clean at forecast time;
the realised price must never be used.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                   | Description                                  | Default   |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|-----------|
| data_home | [DataHome](`spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.exog_providers.DataHome`) | Root data directory forwarded to the loader. | `None`    |
